name: UniPC (B1, bh1)
plain: Unified predictor-corrector working on x0 in VP coordinates. Each step's corrector call also serves as the history for the next step, which gives one model call per step at up to third order. The default bh1 variant uses B(h)=h with a sign flip.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
VP-wrapped: x_vp=x/√(1+σ²), ε=(x_ve−D)/σ, data prediction m=(x_vp−s ε)/a, a=1/√(1+σ²), s=σa, λ=log(a/s)=−log σ.
h=λ_t−λ_0; x*=(s_t/s_0)x−a_t(e^{−h}−1)m₀; r_k=(λ_k−λ_0)/h; D_k=(m_k−m₀)/r_k.
Predictor: x_p=x*−a_tB(h)Σρ_p,kD_k. Corrector: m_t=model(x_p,t); x'=x*−a_tB(h)(Σρ_c,kD_k+ρ_c,last(m_t−m₀)).
ρ from solving R·ρ=b; order 2 predictor uses ρ=½ directly; order 1 corrector uses ρ=½.
Variant: B(h)=−h (hh).
Driver order=min(3,len(sigmas)−2). Step 0 evaluates only and does not move x; last index does 2 updates, the second without corrector. Total calls=N, total updates=N; orders lowered at end.
End: sigma 0 replaced with 0.001; after loop x/=a(last).

props.prediction_space: x0 in VP coordinates, λ=−log σ
props.final_sigma0: Replaces σ=0 with 0.001, so x ends at that σ. Writes it through a view, mutating the sigmas tensor in place.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch. The VP scaling conversion makes the first-order step reduce to the Euler line in x coordinates (algebra). KSAMPLER then applies CONST inverse_noise_scaling with the mutated σ=0.001, dividing the result by 0.999.

surprise: sigmas[:] is a view, so sigmas[-1] stays 0.001 for KSAMPLER's inverse scaling (and for a caller's tensor when no device copy happened). N=1 makes one call and returns the scaled input without moving (read, not run). KSampler discards the penultimate σ for it.
